comment: The new-runtime gap table (#2256). This file is the only copy: #2256 links here. Each row is a gap between OpenTofu's new runtime (internal/engine) and what choudoufu needs, how it is handled while TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME is on, and what closes it. check is one of: live (G's refusal, #2339), preflight (refused on the configuration or state before planning), post_plan (refused on the plan before it is shown or saved), engine (a diagnostic raised inside planning), accepted (not refused; named in the toggle's warning), none. Preflight and post-plan rows also run on apply PLANFILE with the toggle on. Upstream issues and PRs are written as `#NNNN` and are opentofu/opentofu's.

rows.gap: any live mode on the new runtime
rows.interim: refused where the runtime is chosen (any ConfigValueAdjuster set), and where NewRuntimeEnabled() is checked (#2339)
rows.closed_by: U6 (#2342) lifts the first check; the second stays until upstream calls _NEXT stable

rows.gap: markers and records at apply time
markers on the create half of a replace
rows.interim: refuse replace actions in live mode

rows.gap: cycle on a replace with newly enabled create_before_destroy
rows.interim: refuse replace actions outside live mode too, so a plan cannot half-apply
ported by U8 (#2344): the new runtime's planning engine writes the configured destroy-time arguments into the delete's prior state, and its apply engine sends them from the plan

rows.gap: moved blocks (not yet treated as active)
upgrade of orphaned or deposed objects
rows.interim: refuse when state holds deposed objects

rows.warning: Ctrl-C and stop may not stop an apply cleanly
state after a failed or partial apply may differ from the default runtime's
behaviours upstream's own tests still skip without a category (TestContext2Apply_inconsistentWithPlan, TestContext2Apply_multiProviderDestroy and others)

rows.interim: refuse check blocks and precondition and postcondition blocks
refuse sensitive = true variables and outputs and the sensitive() function
rows.warning: attributes a provider schema marks sensitive may not be handled as sensitive

rows.interim: error on any deferral not caused by -target or -exclude; plans have no record of deferral, so a post-plan check cannot see one
refuse the test command (its harness still evaluates on the default runtime)

rows.gap: deprecation warnings on variables and outputs
rows.warning: deprecation warnings on variables and outputs are not shown
built-in lint rules do not run

rows.closed_by: upstream #4768; see #2336 for the taint decision
